_comment: Single source of truth for business/site data used by the generator. Values mirror the live site; nothing here is invented. Fields marked null are unknown and must come from the owner (see docs/seo/OWNER-INPUT-REQUIRED.md).

dispatcher.status: owner decision 2026-11-28: ONE public number for calls and WhatsApp (+34 605 259 206); call forwarding to the AI dispatcher is already configured by the owner. The former number +34 865 699 969 must not appear anywhere public.

contactLanguages.note: The AI dispatcher works in Spanish only. English/Hungarian phone support is NOT verified - do not claim it. English contact is offered via WhatsApp only; real language coverage is a pending owner confirmation.

assistantNote.es: Las llamadas las atiende un asistente virtual en español. Para comunicarte en inglés, escribe por WhatsApp.
assistantNote.en: Calls are answered by a Spanish-speaking virtual assistant. To communicate in English, please use WhatsApp.

serviceAreas._comment: Owner-approved service area (2026-11-28): the SAME 18 towns as the fixed travel-fee list in data/prices.json (travel.towns). Footers, home, areas pages, calculator and structured data all use this list. Departure town is deliberately not stated. No further city pages in this work package.
